title: Kerchief
summary: KER'CHIEF, noun [contracted from coverchief.] 1. A head dress; a cloth to cover the head. 2. A cloth used in dress. The word is now seldom used, except in its compound, handkerchief, and sometimes nec

inlines.v: KER'CHIEF, noun [contracted from coverchief.] 1. A head dress; a cloth to cover the head. 2. A cloth used in dress. The word is now seldom used, except in its compound, handkerchief, and sometimes neckerchief.
